en: I set out for Celestic Town, but a huddle of Pokémon was sitting right across the road.
Heaven knows what they're doing there. They wouldn't budge an inch.
text: Am pornit spre Orășelul Celestic, dar o grămăjoară de Pokémoni stătea chiar în mijlocul drumului.
Numai cerul știe ce fac acolo. Nu se clinteau nici un centimetru.

en: There was a huddle of Pokémon blocking the road up to Celestic Town.
I do believe they've gone now.
text: O grămăjoară de Pokémoni bloca drumul spre Orășelul Celestic.
